name: subscribe__keepalive_deterministic
description: Deterministic counterpart to subscribe__max_interval_keepalive: instead of waiting for the heartbeat to fire by wall-clock, the harness drives the engine via engine_tick_at to a synthetic clock 2500 ms past the harness's start, which it takes before the subscription is admitted. With MaxIntervalCeiling=2 the matter.js-aligned send interval is 2 s — maxInterval × 0.8 = 1.6 s, raised to matter.js's MIN_INTERVAL of 2 s (ServerSubscription.ts) — and a keep-alive is due 2 s after the admission; the engine then ships a ReportData without attribute data. Locks the same heartbeat cadence as Phase P but in <50 ms of test time, demonstrating the clock-injection seam.
